title: Seetelhotels.de — claimed by incransom
description:
DE · Hospitality · Seetel Hotels (SEETEL Hotel GmbH & Co. Betriebs KG) has been notified that a substantial volume of confidential and internal corporate data has been compromised.
 
 The affected data includes, but is not limited to:
 
 Full guest identity records, government-issued passport and ID numbers, payment card details (credit card numbers, CVVs, and expiration dates), direct booking notes, special request
